title: OpenMind marker
description: Instruction or event of a calibration scene, published on openmind/v1/markers and relayed to the LSL markers stream.

label.description: For cues: the expected command (left, right, forward, rest, action).

ts.description: Unix time in seconds (UTC) when the message was created.

trial.description: Trial number from 1, or null outside trials.

scene.description: Scene that emitted the marker, or null.
